name: mirai-go
description: Monorepo foundation for the MiraiGo Japanese learning application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
